notes.text: Conventions colour map uses 'Keyboards' and 'Strings/Brass' but the input list categories are 'keys', 'horns' and 'strings'; mapped Keyboards->keys (Cyan) and Strings/Brass->horns & strings (both Orange).
Drums Comp bus: compressor is 'No Stressor' at -20dB threshold, 20ms attack, 50ms release, per conventions; no compressor field exists in this plan format so it is recorded here.

T Click/Guide is excluded from Main routing per domain knowledge on click/guide tracks ('these tracks must never be routed to the main mix, only to monitor busses'); it still receives the standard monitor-bus sends like every other non-speech channel.

All input-list rows marked 'not patched for this event' were assigned normal channels and patches per this show's instructions ('Ignore all comments in the input list that say not patched for this event').

Vocals bus has no send level specified from any vocal channel; conventions require mix bus sends at unity POST fader, but all vocal channels show null level_db.

Three drum percussion channels are included in the plan despite being marked 'not patched for this event' in the input list; instructions say to ignore these comments, but this should be confirmed since the patch does include them.

VOX 5 is included in the plan and assigned to Vocals DCA and mute group despite being marked 'not patched for this event' in the input list; instructions say to ignore these comments, but presence in the plan should be confirmed.
